recipe.visualDefinition: A central black-and-white photograph of a person from behind, framed by a jagged, torn-edge black paper border with small accents of colored paper scraps and handwritten script text.
coreVisualRelationships: The central figure's white shirt provides a high-contrast focal point against the dark border.
The torn paper edges create a tactile, physical frame for the digital image.
The handwritten text acts as a personal, informal counterpoint to the structured photography.
coreInvariants: Torn paper texture with white fibrous edges
Monochrome central image with shallow depth of field

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary subject is centered, shown from the waist up, occupying the middle 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white shirt of the central figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the central figure, moves to the handwritten text on the right, then circles the torn edges of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space surrounding the central 'window' of the photograph.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted green and blue (small paper scraps)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the center; low saturation overall with small pops of color.

letterConstructionRules: Variable line weight mimicking a felt-tip marker
Connected letters in some words, disconnected in others
characterSpecificRedesigns: The number '4' is drawn with a sharp, open top
The 'y' has a long, looping descender
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single handwritten style paired with a standard sans-serif for metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the informal, personal tone of the original lettering.
Captures the tactile, raw energy of the collage.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a black and white photo of a man from behind in a white t-shirt, standing in a park. Surround this photo with a thick black border that looks like torn paper with white fibrous edges. Add a small scrap of blue torn paper in the bottom left and a scrap of green torn paper in the top right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add handwritten white text in a marker style on the right side of the image, slightly overlapping the central photo.

verificationChecks: Ensure the paper edges look physically torn, not digitally cut.
Check that the central photo is strictly monochrome.
Verify the text looks like authentic handwriting.
Confirm the color scraps are muted and look like paper texture.

adjustableVariables: Jaggedness of the torn paper edges
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of background figures
postGenerationChecks: Is the central figure the clear focal point?
Do the torn edges have visible white paper fibers?
Is the handwriting legible but informal?
Is the overall mood somber and reflective?
recipe.reuseFormula: Central monochrome portrait + torn black paper frame + handwritten marker text + muted color paper accents.
